name: Black&White Photoshoot
source:
A married couple gets in an "awkward position" during a photoshoot in their home.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

Loosely adapted from Stormbringer's short story "[url=http://storiesbystormbringer.blogspot.lt/p/15-xaviers-modeling-job.html]Xavier's Modeling Job[/url]", which also served as a basis for Kaos Comics comic book "[url=http://storiesbystormbringer.blogspot.lt/p/wife-and-black-gardeners-2-comic.html]The Wife and the Black Gardeners 2[/url]".
translation:
一对已婚夫妇在家中拍摄照片时陷入了“尴尬的境地”。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

大致改编自Stormbringer的短篇小说“[url=http://storiesbystormbringer.blogspot.lt/p/15-xaviers-modeling-job.html]Xavier的模特工作[/url]”，该作品也是Kaos Comics漫画书“[url=http://storiesbystormbringer.blogspot.lt/p/wife-and-black-gardeners-2-comic.html]的基础妻子与黑园丁2[/url]”。
